name: adr-studio
description: Drag-and-drop system architecture canvas with an AI design assistant. Designs compile to architecture.spec.json for coding agents.

adrStudio.specPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the architecture spec the canvas reads and writes.

adrStudio.provider.description: Which LLM provider powers the design assistant. Set the key via 'ADR Studio: Set LLM API Key'.

adrStudio.model.description: Anthropic model the design assistant uses (when provider is anthropic).

adrStudio.openaiModel.description: OpenAI model the design assistant uses (when provider is openai).

adrStudio.openrouterModel.description: OpenRouter model used by the design assistant (when provider is openrouter).

adrStudio.groqModel.description: Groq model used by the design assistant (when provider is groq).

adrStudio.togetherModel.description: Together AI model used by the design assistant (when provider is together).

adrStudio.deepseekModel.description: DeepSeek model used by the design assistant (when provider is deepseek).

adrStudio.openaiCompatibleBaseUrl.description: Base URL for a custom OpenAI-compatible chat completions API, e.g. a self-hosted gateway. Used when provider is openai-compatible.

adrStudio.openaiCompatibleModel.description: Model name for the custom OpenAI-compatible provider.

adrStudio.repoPath.description: Path to the repo whose real architecture 'Scan repo' infers and checks for drift. Empty = the open workspace folder.

adrStudio.optionCount.description: How many candidate designs to generate from the top-level 'Generate options' command. Co-design suggestions default to one recommendation unless the prompt asks for alternatives.

scripts.build: npm run build:webview && npm run build:host
